title: Soldiers Of Imam - e - Zaman
body:
Soldiers of imam - e - zaman
O our master
O the living imam(a.s.)
Help, help, help
<<MINI>>
Imam-e-zama'n al-muntazar(a.s.)
We want to be you soldier
We all are waiting for you imam-e-zaman(a.s.) (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
We want, we want to fight by your side master
Will you, will you come and make the world brigher
<<MINI>>
Dont make us wait much longer
We want to be your soldier
Imam-e-zama'n al-muntazar(a.s.)
We want to be you soldier
We all are waiting for you imam-e-zaman(a.s.) (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
We pray for you to save us our imam(a.s.)
O listen o listen to us hier of holy quraan
Raise your followers from their slumber

We want to be your soldier
Imam-e-zama'n al-muntazar(a.s.)
We want to be you soldier
We all are waiting for you imam-e-zaman(a.s.) (x2)

Please come n help us take a stand
You will surely defeat evil from every land
You are a saviour for all master
